senses.en_definition: A town or city where people, businesses and administrative activities are concentrated.
A port town or city on the coast or a river.

collocations.en: irrigation channel in a paddy field

senses.en_definition: (Indonesian) The banker in a gambling game; figuratively, someone who secretly directs or finances illicit activities.

messages.en: Let's meet in town this evening. It'll be easier to find somewhere to eat.
Sure, but I don't finish work until six. Where shall we meet?
Outside that bookshop next to the market. You can make it by half past six, right?
I'm so proud of you! You won the competition!
Thanks! You helped me a lot when I was practising, too.

senses.en_definition: To wake up or get out of bed.
To rise from a sitting or lying position; to stand up.
To regain consciousness after fainting or being unconscious.

collocations.en: not yet have regained consciousness after fainting

senses.en_definition: To become aware of one's circumstances and be roused to action; to rally.
Of dough or batter: to rise or expand.
Of solidified oil or fat: to melt or become liquid again.

collocations.en: heat the fat until it melts

senses.en_definition: The shape, form, build or structure of a person or thing.
(Archaic) A fine or compensation paid for killing someone or causing harm or loss.

messages.en: Are you up yet? Let's grab breakfast at the place downstairs.
Just woke up. Give me ten minutes to have a quick shower. I'll message you when I'm ready.

senses.en_definition: A building, such as a house, office block or shop.

messages.en: I'm at the building next to the bank. Where are you?
I'm behind that building, near the car park entrance. Just keep walking straight ahead and you'll see me.
